pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which book of the Bible begins with the words "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis
   B. Luke
   C. Psalms
   D. Exodus

2. What does Ephesians 4:26 teach about anger? (1 mark)
   A. Keep anger for a week
   B. Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   C. Never feel angry
   D. Always hit back

3. How can a smile help others? (1 mark)
   A. It has no effect
   B. It hurts them
   C. It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   D. It makes them angry

4. Which person in the Bible chose not to defile himself with the king's food? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Samson
   C. Balaam
   D. Daniel

5. What is a consequence? (1 mark)
   A. A type of song
   B. A result of what we choose
   C. A school subject
   D. A holiday

6. Why is it important to know your family members? (1 mark)
   A. So you can avoid them
   B. So you can forget them
   C. So you can boast
   D. It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related

7. Which commandment says, "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:16
   B. Exodus 20:15
   C. Exodus 20:3
   D. Exodus 20:12

8. Someone offers you sweets and asks you to keep a secret. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Go with them
   B. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   C. Accept and hide it
   D. Ask for more

9. Which of these is a safe touch? (1 mark)
   A. A touch that scares you
   B. A hug from a parent
   C. Touching your private parts by a stranger
   D. A touch you have been told to keep secret

10. Which of these shows God's love? (1 mark)
   A. He ignores prayers
   B. He gave us Jesus to save us
   C. He hides from people
   D. He punishes for no reason

11. What does "holy" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fast
   B. Rich
   C. Old
   D. Pure, perfect and set apart

12. How many books are in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 39
   C. 66
   D. 12

13. Which verse says that God has engraved His people on the palms of His hands? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Isaiah 49:16
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Genesis 1:27

14. Which word best describes a person who is honest even when nobody sees? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Pride
   C. Jealousy
   D. Integrity

15. How did the crowd react when Jesus went to Zacchaeus' house? (1 mark)
   A. They followed Zacchaeus
   B. They cheered
   C. They were silent
   D. They grumbled

16. Which lesson do we learn from Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. Obey God and speak only what He says
   B. Ignore God
   C. Follow money
   D. Curse enemies

17. How many times did the donkey turn aside or stop before she spoke? (1 mark)
   A. One
   B. Three
   C. Seven
   D. Five

18. Who was told by an angel that they would have a son called Samson? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. Balak
   C. Ruth
   D. His parents

19. What did the seven thin cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven towns
   B. Seven servants
   C. Seven years of plenty
   D. Seven years of famine

20. Which verse says that the fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Proverbs 1:7
   C. John 3:16
   D. Luke 1:37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. List three ways of using money wisely. (3 marks)

22. Explain four reasons why children should honour their parents. (5 marks)

23. Name two things that Samson did in Judges 14:5-9. (2 marks)

24. Explain what Psalm 119:105 teaches about how the Bible helps us to make right choices. (4 marks)

25. Give three ways of obeying God in daily life. (3 marks)

26. Explain how the story of Samson and the lion shows God's power. (3 marks)

27. Why is being joyful important for a Christian? Give three reasons. (3 marks)

28. Name the three places in the journey of Abram, in order. (2 marks)

29. Explain how the books of the Old Testament are grouped, giving the number of books in each group. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Genesis
   Genesis 1:1 is the opening line of the Bible.

2. B — Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   The verse says that we should not sin when angry and should settle it quickly.

3. C — It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   Small acts of kindness like a smile encourage others.

4. D — Daniel
   Daniel 1:8 says that he decided not to defile himself.

5. B — A result of what we choose
   A consequence is the result of a choice.

6. D — It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   Knowing family helps in respect and relationships.

7. D — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 is the commandment on honouring parents.

8. B — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Gifts with secrets are a warning sign.

9. B — A hug from a parent
   A hug from a parent is safe and loving.

10. B — He gave us Jesus to save us
   John 3:16 shows God's love in giving His Son.

11. D — Pure, perfect and set apart
   God is holy because He never does wrong.

12. B — 39
   The Old Testament has 39 books.

13. B — Isaiah 49:16
   Isaiah 49:16 uses this picture to show that God does not forget us.

14. D — Integrity
   Integrity means doing right when nobody is watching.

15. D — They grumbled
   Luke 19:7 says they all began to mutter.

16. A — Obey God and speak only what He says
   Balaam had to speak only God's words.

17. B — Three
   Balaam struck her three times.

18. D — His parents
   The angel of the Lord appeared to Samson's parents.

19. D — Seven years of famine
   The thin cows were seven years of famine.

20. B — Proverbs 1:7
   Proverbs 1:7 says this.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Save some, spend on needs first, give to those in need, avoid wasting, do not steal or cheat, keep a record.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: God commands it (Exodus 20:12); parents care for us; it brings peace at home; it brings God's blessing; it sets an example for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason up to 4, and 1 mark for a clear explanation.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: He killed a lion with his bare hands; he ate honey from the lion's body and shared it with his parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: A lamp lights the path so that we can see where to step. The Bible shows us what is right and wrong so that we can choose safely. It guides us in the dark, that is, when we are confused.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lamp picture, 1 for guidance to right and wrong, 1 for use when confused, 1 for a clear link to choices.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents and teachers, read and follow the Bible, tell the truth, pray, be kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Samson had no weapon, but the Spirit of the Lord gave him strength to tear a lion apart. This shows God's power is greater than any danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for no weapon, 1 for the Spirit giving strength, 1 for God's power.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us healthy in mind; it cheers others; it helps us face problems; it shows trust in God. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ur, Haran, Canaan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct places and 1 mark for the correct order.

29. (5 marks)
   Answer: Law has 5 books, history has 12 books, poetry and wisdom has 5 books, and the prophets have 17 books. Together they make 39 books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each group with number, and 1 mark for the total.
